description: This Java class manages Bluetooth operations within an Android application, including starting, stopping, restarting Bluetooth discovery, handling Bluetooth device detection, and broadcasting Bluetooth status updates.

classes.name: BluetoothManager
classes.description: Manages Bluetooth discovery, connection, and status broadcasting within an Android app, utilizing a HandlerThread for asynchronous operations.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops Bluetooth discovery and broadcasts the stopped status.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth discovery, registers receivers, and broadcasts the starting status.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Stops and then restarts Bluetooth discovery, waiting for thread termination.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Placeholder for setting Bluetooth device name (not implemented).

methods.name: isAlive
methods.description: Checks if the BluetoothHandlerThread is active.

methods.name: sendBroadcast
methods.description: Sends Bluetooth status updates via local broadcast.

methods.name: sendFoundBroadcast
methods.description: Broadcasts a found Bluetooth device as a peer.
